b01-two-buses.observed_description: Two white-and-blue city buses stand one behind the other at a bus stop with a shelter; the front bus shows a small route number.
b01-two-buses.note: Usable: two buses read at 180 px; the small route number is not part of the lesson.

b02-three-watches.observed_description: A still life: three wristwatches (silver, gold, black) side by side on a light wooden table.
b02-three-watches.note: Usable: three watches read at 180 px.

b03-two-men.observed_description: Two men (grey jacket, dark blue sweater) walk side by side on a city sidewalk, smiling.
b03-two-men.note: Usable: two men read at 180 px; nobody else.

b04-three-women.observed_description: Three women (red sweater, white shirt, yellow jacket) sit laughing on a park bench.
b04-three-women.note: Usable: three women read at 180 px; nobody else.
